reason: All four values are NZGDA member-studio survey full-time-equivalent values, but the responding count changes 21, 33, 33, 30; 2011 uses September while 2012-2014 use 31 March; no population gross-up or continuous panel is established. The country catalogue marks NZ_fte chart_eligible but trend_eligible false. The 2014 source additionally distinguishes 450 FTE professionals from several hundred part-time developers without defining their relationship to the FTE total.
allowed_rendering: Four unconnected dots, one per stated reference date, each labelled FTE and NZGDA member-studio survey. A common source-family legend is allowed. If spatially grouped, use a visual gap/no connecting stroke and a note that respondent coverage changes.
forbidden_joins: 2011 to 2012, 2012 to 2013, or 2013 to 2014 as a line, slope, or annual growth statement
the four early NZGDA markers to later NZ_fulltime, NZ_workers, or NZ_fte catalogue observations as an uninterrupted index
conversion of FTE to people/headcount, including comparison to AU ABS people
back-calculation of a 2010 value from the 2011 claimed job growth
replacement of the 2014 reported 450 with 434 implied by a later release
